composition_narrative.how_parts_connect: A single rectangular frame hangs from one hinge post. Three horizontal rails divide the leaf. Primary vertical pickets run full height with large finials extending above the top rail. Secondary shorter pickets sit between primaries in the upper section, each with a smaller finial above the middle rail. Below the middle rail, filler pickets double the vertical density for a dog-bar safety zone.
composition_narrative.why_layout: Single leaf suits narrower or side openings where one pivot is enough. Mid-height finials add Victorian ornament without closing the gate. Dense lower zone blocks small gaps. One hinge side keeps hardware simple versus double-leaf meeting stiles.
distinctive_features: Single leaf only — no center meeting stile
Three-rail layout with middle rail at roughly one-third height
Two-tier finial heights (large top, small mid)
100 percent denser pickets below middle rail
Straight top rail in primary reference photo
